resources.string:
Stremini Screen Scanner provides security analysis across all apps on your device. This service can:
• Read screen content from any app to detect scams and phishing attempts • Analyze messages, posts, and links for suspicious patterns • Display safety tags near potentially dangerous content • Work system-wide to protect you everywhere
Your privacy is important: Screen content is only analyzed when you manually activate the scanner by tapping the scanner icon in the Stremini floating bubble.
This service will NOT: • Automatically read your screen without your permission • Store or share your personal data • Track your activity • Access content when scanner is not active
